name: saalik-app-workspace
description: Saalik Nepal heritage workspace: seed corpus, Hybrid Geo-Visual API, and shared tooling

scripts.dev:all: npx --yes concurrently -k -n api,mobile,ntb "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend/saalik-mobile run start" "npm --prefix apps/ntb-command-center run dev"
scripts.seed:db: npm run seed:compile && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.verify:all: npm run server:typecheck && npm --prefix frontend/saalik-mobile exec -- tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix backend exec -- tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix apps/ntb-command-center exec -- tsc --noEmit && npm test -- --watchAll=false && npm --prefix backend test -- --watchAll=false && SAALIK_ML_FAKE=1 SAALIK_SEED_MOCK=1 ml_pipeline/.venv/bin/pytest ml_pipeline/tests/ -q
